description: THE GENERAL MEETING DECIDES TO AMEND THE BANK'S ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION AS FOLLOWS: PARAGRAPH 14 ELECTION AND REMOVAL OF SUPERVISORY BOARD MEMBERS, PARAGRAPH 1, NEWLY READS /1/ THE SUPERVISORY BOARD CONSISTS OF TWELVE MEMBERS, NATURAL PERSONS WHO MEET THE CONDITIONS SET BY GENERALLY BINDING LEGAL REGULATIONS AND WHO HAVE NO OBSTACLE TO PERFORMING THE FUNCTION UNDER THE BUSINESS CORPORATIONS ACT. THE TERM OF OFFICE IS 4 YEARS. TWO-THIRDS OF THE SUPERVISORY BOARD MEMBERS ARE ELECTED AND REMOVED BY THE GENERAL MEETING, AND ONE-THIRD ARE ELECTED AND REMOVED BY THE BANK'S EMPLOYEES. ONLY EMPLOYEES IN AN EMPLOYMENT RELATIONSHIP WITH THE BANK MAY VOTE FOR EMPLOYEE-ELECTED SUPERVISORY BOARD MEMBERS. THE ELECTION RULES ARE SET OUT IN THE BANK'S ELECTION RULES PREPARED AND APPROVED BY THE BOARD AFTER CONSULTATION WITH THE TRADE UNION. PARAGRAPH 16 SUPERVISORY BOARD MEETINGS, PARAGRAPH 3, NEWLY READS /3/ THE SUPERVISORY BOARD HAS A QUORUM IF AT LEAST SEVEN MEMBERS ARE PRESENT. A MAJORITY OF ALL SUPERVISORY BOARD MEMBERS IS REQUIRED TO ADOPT A RESOLUTION. MEMBERS WHO ARE RELATED PARTIES UNDER THE CAPITAL MARKET ACT DO NOT PARTICIPATE IN ASSESSING EXCEPTIONS TO APPROVAL AND DISCLOSURE OF SIGNIFICANT RELATED-PARTY TRANSACTIONS. PARAGRAPH 39 FINAL PROVISIONS, NEWLY READS THE BANK HAS SUBMITTED TO THE BUSINESS CORPORATIONS ACT BASED ON THE RESOLUTION OF THE GENERAL MEETING OF 28 JANUARY 2014, EFFECTIVE FROM 10 MARCH 2014. THIS AMENDMENT TO THE ARTICLES BECOMES VALID AND EFFECTIVE UPON APPROVAL BY THE GENERAL MEETING. DECISION ON AMENDMENTS TO THE ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION

description: THE GENERAL MEETING AUTHORIZES THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE COMPANY TO ACQUIRE TREASURY SHARES SIMULTANEOUSLY SETTING ASIDE RESOLUTION NO. 10 OF THE ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF 2025 PURSUANT TO THE FOLLOWING TERMS AND CONDITIONS: MODE OF ACQUISITION OF TREASURY SHARES: WITH OR WITHOUT CONSIDERATION, EITHER ON THE STOCK EXCHANGE OR THROUGH PUBLIC OFFER OR ON THE OTC MARKET IF NOT PROHIBITED BY LEGAL REGULATIONS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO ACQUIRING SHARES BY EXERCISING RIGHTS ENSURED BY FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS FOR ACQUIRING TREASURY SHARES (EG.: CALL RIGHT, EXCHANGE RIGHT ETC.). THE AUTHORIZATION EMPOWERS THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS TO ACQUIRE ANY TYPE OF SHARES ISSUED BY THE COMPANY WITH ANY PAR VALUE. THE AMOUNT (NUMBER) OF SHARES THAT CAN BE ACQUIRED: THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF NOMINAL VALUE OF TREASURY SHARES OWNED BY THE COMPANY AT ANY TIME MAY NOT EXCEED 25 % OF THE ACTUAL SHARE CAPITAL OF THE COMPANY. THE PERIOD OF VALIDITY OF THE AUTHORIZATION: FROM THE DATE OF THE RESOLUTION MADE BY THE GENERAL MEETING FOR AN 18 MONTHS PERIOD. IF THE ACQUISITION OF THE TREASURY SHARES IS IN RETURN FOR A CONSIDERATION, THE MINIMUM AMOUNT WHICH CAN BE PAID FOR ONE PIECE OF SHARE IS HUF 1, WHILE THE MAXIMUM AMOUNT CANNOT EXCEED 150 % OF THE HIGHEST OF THE FOLLOWING PRICES: A.) THE HIGHEST PRICE OF THE DEALS CONCLUDED WITH MOL SHARES ON THE BUDAPEST STOCK EXCHANGE (BET) ON THE DATE OF THE TRANSACTION OR B.) THE HIGHEST DAILY VOLUME WEIGHTED AVERAGE PRICE OF MOL SHARES ON ANY OF THE 90 BET TRADING DAYS PRIOR TO THE DATE OF THE TRANSACTION OR C.) THE VOLUME-WEIGHTED AVERAGE PRICE OF MOL SHARES DURING 90 BET TRADING DAYS PRIOR TO (I) THE DATE OF SIGNING THE AGREEMENT FOR ACQUIRING THE TREASURY SHARES (PARTICULARLY PURCHASE AGREEMENT, CALL OPTION AGREEMENT OR OTHER COLLATERAL AGREEMENT), OR (II) THE DATE OF ACQUISITION OF FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS ENSURING RIGHTS TO ACQUIRE TREASURY SHARES OR (III) THE DATE OF EXERCISING OPTION RIGHTS, PRE-EMPTION RIGHTS; RIGHTS ENSURED BY COLLATERAL OR BY FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS FOR ACQUIRING TREASURY SHARES OR D.) THE CLOSING PRICE OF MOL SHARES ON THE BET ON THE TRADING DAY WHICH FALLS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO (I) THE DATE OF SIGNING THE AGREEMENT FOR ACQUIRING THE TREASURY SHARES (PARTICULARLY PURCHASE AGREEMENT, CALL OPTION AGREEMENT OR OTHER COLLATERAL AGREEMENT), OR (II) THE DATE OF ACQUISITION OF FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS ENSURING RIGHTS TO ACQUIRE TREASURY SHARES OR (III) THE DATE OF EXERCISING OPTION RIGHTS, PREEMPTION RIGHTS; RIGHTS ENSURED BY COLLATERAL OR BY FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS FOR ACQUIRING TREASURY SHARES. AUTHORIZATION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS TO ACQUIRE TREASURY SHARES IN ACCORDANCE WITH SECTION 3:223 (1) OF THE CIVIL CODE
